title: Invalid: a MAIN claim's any_of mixes an acceptable class with an unrelated one, so no branch is guaranteed

acceptance_criteria.statement: N/A -- this fixture exists only to prove AS54-F003: an any_of that MIXES an acceptable class (CI_ATTESTED) with an unrelated one (ACTOR_REPORTED) does not guarantee the acceptable class, since the ACTOR_REPORTED branch alone would also satisfy any_of, and this claim's all_of never supplies the missing class either.

claims.statement: This change reached the protected main branch, but the evidence requirement can be closed via the ACTOR_REPORTED branch alone, never actually requiring CI_ATTESTED or INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED.
